method: Billing owner configured MySQL account over SSH; a single REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY consistent snapshot; global intent count gate <=100000 before source export; source restricted by authentic intent payload to channel/11; all matching intents and their events preserved without time filtering; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME=10000 per SELECT; original PK/payload/digest and nullable amounts unchanged in private SQLite; no production writes; no local-attempts fixtures
local_preparation: Private local SQLite only: preset PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL, wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)=(0,0,0), integrity_check=ok, then close all connections; required because existing xdb Open applies WAL unconditionally; table rows/PK/payload/digest unchanged; production untouched. Preview must use SQLite URI mode=ro and verify main DB hash before/after.
